dishes.name: Ulmer Zuckerbrot
dishes.desc: Sweet, thin yeast bread coated in sugar, a bakery specialty of Ulm since the 17th century.

dishes.name: Dinnete
dishes.desc: Swabian Alb flatbread baked in a hot oven with cream, bacon and onions, eaten in country inns.

dishes.name: Swabian potato salad
dishes.desc: Warm, soupy potato salad dressed in broth, vinegar and onion. Served with sausage in Ulm and on the Alb.

dishes.name: Saure Kutteln
dishes.desc: Tripe in a sour sauce with vinegar and onions, a Swabian inn classic of Ulm and the Alb.

dishes.name: Ofenschlupfer
dishes.desc: Baked bread pudding with apples and raisins, served with vanilla sauce. A Swabian home dessert.
